steps: Claim to be a CBI inspector reporting illegal items found in a parcel linked to your Aadhaar card.
Threaten immediate arrest under an active warrant unless strict secrecy is maintained.
Demand an urgent refundable security deposit to clear the case.
Provide a personal UPI ID and bank account details for immediate fund transfer.
redFlags: A caller claiming to be from the CBI threatens you with an arrest warrant over a phone call.
The caller demands immediate secrecy and instructs you not to tell anyone.
You are asked to transfer a security deposit to an individual's personal UPI or bank account.
strain.paymentMethod: UPI transfer or bank account transfer
